name: quickfile-mcp
description: Multi-account Quickfile accounting API access for Claude (invoicing, clients, suppliers, bank, reports).
long_description: Connects Claude to the Quickfile REST API v2. Supports multiple Quickfile accounts/companies. Provides 75 tools covering invoices, clients, suppliers, purchases, bank transactions, ledgers, journals, reports, projects, documents and inventory. Secrets stay in the OS keychain — never exposed to the AI agent.

accounts_config.title: Accounts (JSON)
accounts_config.description: Paste your accounts config JSON. Example: {"defaultAccount":"importair","accounts":[{"id":"importair","label":"Import Air","type":"static","token":"YOUR_TOKEN"}]}. For OAuth accounts add "type":"oauth","clientId":"...","clientSecret":"..." (token material is managed automatically).
